metadata.name: Daily Utility Dock AI social publishing API examples
metadata.purpose: Reusable Make.com, OpenAI, and Buffer payload examples for automated social scheduling.
metadata.security_note: Replace placeholders in Make.com variables or secrets. Do not commit live API keys, webhook tokens, Buffer organization IDs, or Buffer channel IDs.

make_webhook_payload_example.campaign_theme: evergreen practical online tools for finance, productivity, and internet utilities

content_pool_seed.title: Build a monthly budget that matches real spending
Format and validate JSON before sharing data

input.content: You are the social media publishing assistant for Daily Utility Dock, a website of practical free online tools, calculators, converters, finance utilities, productivity tools, and internet utilities. Write professional, useful, evergreen social posts. Do not write spam, exaggerated claims, fake scarcity, clickbait, or regulated financial/tax/legal advice. Promote only Daily Utility Dock URLs supplied in the content pool. Include exactly one canonical Daily Utility Dock URL per post. Return only JSON that matches the provided schema.

openai_output_example.batch_summary: Evergreen weekly batch covering finance, productivity, and internet utilities.

posts.text: A lower loan payment can still cost more if the term is much longer. Compare monthly repayment and total repayable before you decide what to check next. https://dailyutilitydock.com/tools/loan-repayment-calculator
posts.notes: Educational planning angle; no regulated advice.

posts.text: Small online utilities often remove the friction around everyday work: checking a public IP, formatting JSON for review, creating a UTM link, generating a QR code, or testing a connection before troubleshooting. Daily Utility Dock groups these tasks into lightweight browser tools so users can move from one practical check to the next without opening a full application. https://dailyutilitydock.com/internet-tools

Monthly budget checklist: income, fixed bills, flexible spending, debt repayments, savings, annual costs, and a realistic buffer. Plan the numbers in one place: https://dailyutilitydock.com/tools/budget-planner
posts.pinterest_description: Use this practical checklist to plan income, bills, spending, savings, debt repayments, annual costs, and a small buffer with Daily Utility Dock's free budget planner.
posts.pinterest_image_prompt: Create a clean vertical Pinterest graphic for Daily Utility Dock with the headline Monthly Budget Checklist. Use a calm finance planning style, light background, navy and teal accents, checklist layout, no people, no third-party logos, and generous margins.
posts.notes: Requires generated or selected public image URL before Buffer.

openai_images_request_template_for_pinte.next_step: Upload returned image data to a public image host, then map the public HTTPS URL to public_image_url before sending the Pinterest post to Buffer.

account_query.query: query { account { id email name organizations { id name } } }

channels_query.query: query { channels(input: { organizationId: "{{BUFFER_ORGANIZATION_ID}}" }) { id name service avatar isQueuePaused } }

scheduled_posts_query_template.query: query { posts(first: 10 input: { organizationId: "{{BUFFER_ORGANIZATION_ID}}" filter: { status: [scheduled] channelIds: ["{{BUFFER_CHANNEL_ID}}"] } sort: [{ field: dueAt direction: asc }] }) { edges { node { id text status dueAt channelId } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

create_text_post_custom_schedule_templat.query: mutation CreatePost { createPost(input: { text: "{{ESCAPED_POST_TEXT}}" channelId: "{{BUFFER_CHANNEL_ID}}" schedulingType: automatic mode: customScheduled dueAt: "{{DUE_AT_UTC}}" }) { ... on PostActionSuccess { post { id text status dueAt channelId } } ... on MutationError { message } } }

create_text_post_queue_template.query: mutation CreatePost { createPost(input: { text: "{{ESCAPED_POST_TEXT}}" channelId: "{{BUFFER_CHANNEL_ID}}" schedulingType: automatic mode: addToQueue }) { ... on PostActionSuccess { post { id text status dueAt channelId } } ... on MutationError { message } } }

create_pinterest_image_post_custom_sched.query: mutation CreatePost { createPost(input: { text: "{{ESCAPED_PINTEREST_DESCRIPTION}}" channelId: "{{BUFFER_CHANNEL_PINTEREST}}" schedulingType: automatic mode: customScheduled dueAt: "{{DUE_AT_UTC}}" assets: [{ image: { url: "{{PUBLIC_IMAGE_URL}}" } }] }) { ... on PostActionSuccess { post { id text status dueAt channelId assets { id mimeType } } } ... on MutationError { message } } }

create_pinterest_image_post_queue_templa.query: mutation CreatePost { createPost(input: { text: "{{ESCAPED_PINTEREST_DESCRIPTION}}" channelId: "{{BUFFER_CHANNEL_PINTEREST}}" schedulingType: automatic mode: addToQueue assets: [{ image: { url: "{{PUBLIC_IMAGE_URL}}" } }] }) { ... on PostActionSuccess { post { id text status dueAt channelId assets { id mimeType } } } ... on MutationError { message } } }
